plan: Model the whole check-in state as the single public `session` dictionary (active, contact_confirmed, appointment_id, completed) reset from one initial-session template.
Route `handle` through a dispatch table mapping the six action types to handler methods; anything unrecognized or non-dict yields an error screen.
Enforce validate-then-mutate in every handler: all precondition and payload checks return an error screen before any session field is written, so rejected actions cannot corrupt accepted data.
Centralize screen construction in one builder that emits exactly {prompt, messages, choices}, attaching copied appointment choices in input order precisely when the prompt is 'Choose appointment'.
Compute the post-correction prompt with a next-unmet-step function (contact -> appointment -> review).

Inject `action_source` and `screen_sink` via the constructor so stdlib unittest fakes can replace I/O; `run_once` checks both exist (RuntimeError) before reading one action, handling it, displaying the screen once, and returning the same screen object.
mechanisms: single session-state dictionary with template-based reset
action-type dispatch table over handler methods
centralized deterministic screen builder with prompt-driven choice inclusion
constructor-injected source/sink adapters with guarded run_once
